openPosition.metaDescription: Gimetry Studio is hiring an exceptional Creative Director for a 3–6 month contract in Johor Bahru. Lead brand and digital creative for a studio that cares deeply about the work.

children.text: Gimetry Studio is a brand and digital design studio based in Johor Bahru. I am a designer and developer based in Johor Bahru. I take projects from the first sketch to the deployed site: brand identity, web design and build, motion and 3D, plus the automation and hardware work that sits behind them. One person, so nothing gets lost in a handover.

We’re a small, focused team that care deeply about the work we do. We’re collaborative, honest, and creatively ambitious. We’re grateful to get to do the work we do, and are looking for someone who shares our passion.
We're looking for a Creative Director to join us for 3–6 months to cover a planned leave.
To be direct - we want someone exceptional.

This is a role for someone passionate about design that loves leading creative as much as they love being in it. You'll run the room when a client needs a clear vision. You'll open Figma when the team needs to see what's possible. You'll bring a perspective that's distinctly yours, and we’ll be stoked to see you take the reins and make your mark.
If you love the craft and know how to bring that energy to a team, this is your role.
Creative Direction
Own the creative direction across all active projects, from initial concept through to final delivery
Develop and present concepts to clients and the internal team
Make clear, confident creative decisions and communicate the rationale
Ensure all work reflects the client's brief, their brand standards, and Gimetry Studio's quality bar
Hands-on Design
Build concept decks, moodboards, and direction presentations personally
Design in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite - set the visual standard by example
Review and art direct work in progress with specific, actionable feedback
Team Leadership
Elevate the design team's output by working alongside them - show, don't just tell
Mentor designers through the work, not just around it
Create space for ideas while holding the standard high
Collaboration & Strategy
Partner with strategy on insights-driven creative solutions
Work with project managers to keep quality and timelines aligned
Present work to clients and articulate the creative vision with confidence
6+ years of design experience, with at least 2 years as a Creative Director or senior Art Director
A portfolio full of work you made - not just work you approved
Strong brand identity chops; packaging and digital experience a bonus
Fluency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite
Open to using AI tooling and drive adoption where applicable
Agency or design studio background
The ability to sell a concept to a client and explain a decision to a junior designer in the same afternoon
Location:
Johor Bahru, Malaysia - 4 days in office, 1 day remote
Type:
Contract, 3-6 months
Equipment:
Work laptop provided
Hours:
Monday-Friday, 9am-5pm
Compensation:
$110,000 – $150,000 CAD annualized, depending on experience
We hire people we want to keep working with. Contracts have a way of turning into conversations about what comes next.

At Gimetry Studio, we believe diverse perspectives make better creative work. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. If you're excited about this role but don't check every box, we still want to hear from you.
